pages.title: Otherrock Trader
pages.text: The Otherrock Trader spirit allows to get more $(item)Otherrock$() than using $(item)Spiritfire$().$(br) Thus it is especially efficient if you want to use Otherrock as a building material.$(br)
To trade, drop your offered item next to the trader,$(br)he will pick it up and drop the exchanged item.$(br)
